World Health Assembly resolutions on viral hepatitis Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus Director-General The WHO Global hepatitis report underscores both encouraging progress and an urgent need for acceleration. While countries that have strengthened political commitment are demonstrating tangible results, overall progress remains too slow and uneven to meet the 2030 elimination targets.
